# Place photographs

These images illustrate the real locations in the fictional Alpine Crossing
sample. They are not the traveling group's photographs. Retrieved 20 September
2026. Original images were proportionally resized and encoded as WebP; no scene
content was altered. Cropping in cards is presentation only; the gallery shows
the complete photograph.

- **taube-exterior.webp** — Wirtshaus Taube / Tavolago AG.
  [Media page and permission](https://www.taube-luzern.ch/en/medien) allows
  noncommercial use in connection with Wirtshaus Taube Luzern. This personal
  travel atlas uses it solely on that restaurant's place card/gallery.
  [Published source image](https://www.taube-luzern.ch/bilder/hauptbilder/aussenansicht/_AUTOxAUTO_crop_center-center_none_ns/aussenansicht-wirtshaus-taube-luzern-tavolago-ag-04.jpg?v=1780036546).
  This image is not covered by the Commons licenses below.
- **chapel-bridge.webp** — Ikiwaner,
  [Luzern Kapellbruecke](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Luzern_Kapellbruecke.jpg),
  [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
  The resized derivative is distributed under the same license.
- **chapel-interior.webp** — Tisc5027,
  [Kapellbrücke, Luzern](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kapellbr%C3%BCcke,_Luzern.png),
  [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
  The resized derivative is distributed under the same license.
- **musegg-wall.webp** — Paebi,
  [Museggmauer Nord](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Museggmauer_Nord.JPG),
  [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
  The resized derivative is distributed under the same license.

The same author credits, source links and license/permission links are included
in each journey image record and shown in the gallery.


## Heading East — Google Maps references

At the owner's request, each of the 20 saved places includes one photo selected
from its exact public Google Maps listing on 10 October 2026. The source-hosted
images are external references (`permission: "linked"`), not atlas-owned or
licensed assets. No copies are distributed in this repository. Display names
below are the venue account for business uploads or the contributor shown by
the Maps photo viewer. These images do not document the traveling group's visits.

All images were visually checked. Captions describe the photograph, not a claim
that the venue still looks exactly as pictured. Cards crop for layout; galleries
show the full image. Source URLs and credits are stored with each journey image.
The photo IDs distinguish the selected pictures if the listing's cover changes.
